# 🎮 Start Your Adventure

## Character Creation

Comment below to create your character! Each GitHub user can create one character per issue.

Example comment:
```
I want to create a character named [Your Name], a [Class]
```

### Available Classes

- **Warrior**: High strength and constitution, excels in melee combat
- **Mage**: High intelligence and wisdom, master of magic
- **Rogue**: High dexterity, skilled in stealth and precision
- **Cleric**: High wisdom, healer and support specialist
- **Ranger**: Balanced dexterity and wisdom, expert tracker
- **Paladin**: Balanced strength and wisdom, holy warrior
- **Bard**: High charisma, master of inspiration and magic
- **Monk**: High dexterity and wisdom, unarmed combat specialist
- **Warlock**: High intelligence and charisma, dark magic user
- **Druid**: High wisdom, nature magic user
- **Sorcerer**: High intelligence and charisma, natural magic user
- **Barbarian**: High strength and constitution, fierce warrior

Once your character is created, simply comment with actions in natural language to play!
